items.name: support-reply-draft
items.title: Support Reply Draft
items.description: Drafts a customer reply from product docs and cites the file.
items.author: TommyBez

overview: Support Reply Draft is an eve agent that drafts customer-facing support replies from product help and support documentation. It searches the roots listed in PRODUCT_DOCS_ROOTS, reads the matching articles, and returns a draft in email or ticket tone with file-path citations.
You interact with it through Eve chat sessions only. There is no GitHub channel and no email-send connection. Paste a customer question, get a draft, then copy it into your own mail or ticket tool.

When the product docs do not cover the question, it says so instead of inventing refunds, SLAs, or setup steps. The draft_support_reply tool records the reply text and citations and always reports sent false so the agent never claims delivery.
howItWorks: A support operator pastes a customer question into an Eve chat session.
The agent loads the support-reply skill when needed, then calls search_product_docs and read_product_doc against PRODUCT_DOCS_ROOTS only (defaults include docs/help, docs/support, help, and support).
Those tools refuse application source, tests, configs, and lockfiles. Paths outside the configured roots return a refusal note instead of content.

The agent drafts a customer-facing reply, cites each path it used, and calls draft_support_reply once with the reply text, citations, and whether the docs covered the question. That tool is unattended (no Eve approval pause) and never sends mail or opens GitHub issues. ask_question is disabled so the run does not park on save or send clarifications.
Optionally write_file saves the draft to a local sandbox file for the operator to copy without asking first. Saving a file is not delivery.
Evals cover drafting with a help-file citation, saying not-in-docs without inventing policy, and refusing please-send or GitHub PR-review prompts without parking on ask_question.

useCases.title: Billing and refund replies from help docs
useCases.body: An operator pastes a refund question. The agent reads docs/help/billing.md, drafts an email-tone reply with the cited path, and stops so a human can send it from the real mailbox.

useCases.title: Troubleshooting ticket drafts
useCases.body: A ticket asks how to reset two-factor auth. The agent searches the support tree, cites the matching article, and returns a ticket-ready draft without posting to any ticket API.

useCases.title: Honest gaps when product docs are silent
useCases.body: When a customer asks about an undocumented on-call policy, the agent says the product docs do not cover it rather than inventing SLAs from training data.

useCases.title: Save a draft for handoff
useCases.body: After draft_support_reply returns, the operator can ask the agent to write_file the reply into a local path for review or handoff without implying the message was sent.

requirements.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
requirements.body: A model credential for the deployment, either a Vercel AI Gateway API key or AI Gateway OIDC, so the agent can call the zai/glm-5.2 model.

requirements.name: PRODUCT_DOCS_ROOTS
requirements.body: Comma-separated workspace-relative product documentation roots (placeholder example: docs/help,docs/support,help,support). Keep this narrower than the whole repository.

faqs.question: How do I install and draft a reply?
faqs.answer: Run npx shadcn@latest add @evex/support-reply-draft inside an eve app, set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY and PRODUCT_DOCS_ROOTS, then paste a customer question in Eve chat. Copy the returned draft into your mail or ticket tool yourself.

faqs.question: Does it send email or open GitHub issues?
faqs.answer: No. There is no send tool and no GitHub channel. draft_support_reply always returns sent false. Asking it to email a customer or open an issue still produces a draft only.

faqs.question: Which files can it read?
faqs.answer: Only paths under PRODUCT_DOCS_ROOTS. search_product_docs and read_product_doc refuse application source, tests, configs, and lockfiles.

faqs.question: What happens when the docs do not answer?
faqs.answer: The agent says the product documentation does not cover the question and still does not invent policy. It may still call draft_support_reply with docsCovered set to false.

faqs.question: How is this different from Docs Knowledge Assistant?
faqs.answer: Docs Knowledge Assistant answers developer questions from README, docs/, CONTRIBUTING*, and AGENTS.md and can open a docs-gap GitHub issue. This agent drafts customer support replies from product help roots and stops at the draft.
